citations.label: Buyer states receipt shows 86 CAD but charged 96 CAD

evidence.notes: The order total recorded in the merchant system is 86.00 CAD (order:ORD-2004). The disputed transaction amount is 96.00 CAD (dispute:DEMO-D-2004), resulting in an overcharge of 10.00 CAD. The buyer has identified this discrepancy (msg:DM-1).

input.notes: The buyer was charged 96.00 CAD while the order total is 86.00 CAD, creating a 10.00 CAD overcharge. To resolve, we propose a refund of the difference.
input.rationale: Order total (86 CAD) does not match the charged amount (96 CAD). Offering a 10 CAD refund corrects the overcharge and satisfies the buyer, aligning with the playbook guidance for INCORRECT_AMOUNT disputes.
